## Ingredients

- 126 g chicken breast, cubed  
- 1 teaspoon Cajun seasoning  
- 2 teaspoons extra-virgin olive oil  
- 250 g sweet potato, cubed  
- 175 g broccoli florets  

## Instructions

1. Preheat oven to **425°F (218°C)**. Toss cubed chicken with Cajun seasoning until evenly coated. Refrigerate for 15 minutes while prepping other ingredients.  
2. Line a sheet pan with foil and lightly spray with nonstick spray. Arrange sweet potatoes and broccoli on the pan, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with salt.  
3. Prepare a second sheet pan for the chicken, lining and spraying it the same way.  
4. Bake both pans for **12–15 minutes**. Remove the chicken and broccoli, stir the sweet potatoes, and continue roasting for another **15 minutes** or until tender.  
5. Combine all components or serve separately. Enjoy!

## Notes

- For extra flavor, add a squeeze of lime juice or a drizzle of hot honey before serving.  
- Substitute Cajun seasoning with taco seasoning or smoked paprika for a milder version.
